_comment: Build-time only, like tools/grammar-jlpt.json, tools/jlpt-levels-manual.json and
tools/phonetics-words-manual.json. Nothing at runtime reads this file; it is the
provenance record for a judgement pass.
WHY IT EXISTS. grammar-index.js originally filed only the 132 strings in GRAMMAR_POOLS,
because the pool was the one list of citation forms to hand. But the pool's job is to
supply DISTRACTOR TILES, which is a different job from being a catalogue -- and 131 of the
400 sentences have BOTH of their options outside it, so their explanation and their
translation reached no entry at all. 174 distinct grammar strings are tested on a real
sentence, carry the author's own explanationMn, and were being thrown away.
They are not all grammar. Roughly a third are sentence fragments, vocabulary, or an
orthographic or politeness variant of a point already filed -- the same finding the
Grammar Connect band audit made when it called 21 of 521 slots paraphrase fragments. So
each one is filed here by hand, exactly once, and the build FAILS on a string that is in
neither list. A new sentence introducing a new form must therefore be classified
deliberately; it cannot be dropped in silence, which is what the pool filter was doing.
`points` maps a tested string to the HEADWORD it is filed under. Where the two differ the
entry MERGES: a politeness or orthographic variant (とはかぎりません, ないわけにはいきません,
てはなりません) joins its citation form rather than sitting beside it as a near-duplicate
row, and a key that captured a whole clause (からといって、すべてが...) is filed under the
point it was really testing. Merging is also how the two pool strings that are in the pool
but never tested -- がち and まえに -- finally get an entry: they had no explanation of
their own because no sentence tests them, and がちだ / しがちだ / の前に do.
`notGrammar` records every rejection WITH ITS REASON, because the rejections are the half
that cannot be rederived. The categories are: a vocabulary word (はずれる, あふれている,
経験がある), a conjugated fragment of the sentence rather than a pattern
(とてもむずかしいです, ほとんどいなかった), a bare particle or copula where the explanation is
really about the other side (だ, も, まで), and an orthographic variant the author's own
explanation already calls identical (はかりしれないものがある).
A key with furigana and no *Core field is skipped by the generator without appearing here:
a conjugated form carrying <ruby> has no citation form at all, so there is nothing to file
it under. 149 keys are in that state, and they are the visible face of the 37 sentences
that want oldCore/newCore adding to grammar-data.js. The build prints the count.

points.としか言いようがない: としか言いようがない
points.と言っても差し支えない: と言っても差し支えない
points.ないわけにはいかない: ないわけにはいかない
points.ないわけにはいきません: ないわけにはいかない

notGrammar.あふれている: vocabulary: the verb 溢れている. The explanation contrasts it with 富んでいる, two words for abundance, not two patterns.
notGrammar.かけ離れる: vocabulary: the verb かけ離れる.
notGrammar.はずれている: vocabulary: the verb 外れている.
notGrammar.経験がある: vocabulary: 経験 + がある. The point under test is たことがある, which is already filed.
notGrammar.可能性がある: vocabulary: 可能性 + がある. おそれがある is the pattern this pair is teaching and is filed.
notGrammar.気にせず: vocabulary: 気にする negated. The pattern is をよそに.
notGrammar.左右されず: vocabulary: 左右される negated. The pattern is に関係なく.
notGrammar.意に介さず: a fixed lexical phrase, not a productive pattern; をものともせず is the point.
notGrammar.そしりを免れない: a fixed lexical phrase (そしり = reproach); ざるをえない is the point.
notGrammar.形で: vocabulary: 形 + で, a noun used adverbially.
notGrammar.状態で: vocabulary: 状態 + で. まま is the pattern.
notGrammar.状態が続いている: a sentence fragment, and the exact example CLAUDE.md already names as not grammar.
notGrammar.範囲では: vocabulary: 範囲 + では. 限り is the pattern.
notGrammar.最後には: vocabulary: 最後 + には; しまいには is the pattern and is filed.
notGrammar.とてもむずかしいです: a conjugated fragment of the sentence, not a pattern. すぎる is the point.
notGrammar.たかいだけです: a conjugated fragment of the sentence.
notGrammar.ほとんどいなかった: a conjugated fragment; 皆無に近い is the point.
notGrammar.ほど大きい: a conjugated fragment; 計り知れない is the point.
notGrammar.し足りない: a conjugated fragment of 称賛し足りない; てもしきれない is the point.
notGrammar.そうなほど: a conjugated fragment; んばかりに is the point.
notGrammar.してふさわしくないものだ: a conjugated fragment; 恥ずべきものだ is the point.
notGrammar.わかりません: the plain polite negative of a verb, not a pattern.
notGrammar.だけで: a fragment: だけ + the て-form of the copula. だけ is filed on its own.
notGrammar.であって: the て-form of the copula; the pair is really teaching だけ.
notGrammar.なければ: the plain conditional; the point is なくして.
notGrammar.なので: the copula + ので; the point is とあって.
notGrammar.そうな: the attributive form of そう, which is in the pool and already filed.
notGrammar.ている: the plain progressive. The pair is teaching ておく.
notGrammar.てみると: てみる + と, both basic; the point is 振り返るに.
notGrammar.にくくない: the negative of にくい, which is already filed. A negated form of a filed point is not a second point.
notGrammar.にしかできない: しか...ない around できる, i.e. two filed pieces; the point is ならでは.
notGrammar.はかりしれないものがある: an orthographic variant -- the author's own explanation says 'same grammar, same meaning, just written with or without kanji'.
notGrammar.という噂だ: vocabulary: 噂 + という. らしい is the point.
notGrammar.という話だ: vocabulary: 話 + という. らしい is the point, and this is the same shape as という噂だ.
notGrammar.も: a bare particle; the point is たりとも.
notGrammar.まで: a bare particle used here as a time limit; the point is ないうちは.
